parsed.scene_description: The image shows a room with a blue tiled floor and white walls. On the left side of the image, there is a white radiator with a fan on top of it. Next to the radiator, there are two shelves with blue boxes on them. The shelves appear to be made of metal and have wheels for easy movement. In the background, there appears to be a desk with a computer monitor and other office supplies. The room is dimly lit, with a clock hanging on the wall.
